notes: Review of all research reviewed. Approved from my side, with added ecotherapy for the patient.

draft.assessment: The patient exhibits moderate PTSD symptom severity by CAPS-5 and PCL-5 with a prior EMDR response, currently managed on sertraline and with alcohol-use comorbidity. There is clinical discordance between PTSD symptom measures and brief general screening results, necessitating a direct, contemporaneous assessment of risk, symptom burden, and functional impairment. The draft plan emphasizes safety, measurement-based monitoring, sertraline review, trauma-focused psychotherapy re-engagement (with EMDR reconsideration), and integrated PTSD-alcohol treatment planning, while clearly avoiding autonomous medication changes or unvalidated interventions. Clinician review and amendment are required before use with a patient.

recommended_plan.text: Initiate an urgent, contemporaneous safety assessment (suicide and violence risk) with an explicit crisis plan and clear escalation pathways; assess withdrawal risk related to alcohol use and document a safety-net plan.
recommended_plan.rationale: Direct assessment of suicide risk and withdrawal/relapse risk is mandatory given current flags and comorbidity; establishes immediate safety and coordinated care.
cautions: Incorporate crisis management planning and ensure escalation pathways are clear

recommended_plan.text: Reassess PTSD symptom burden with repeated, validated measures (PCL-5 and/or CAPS-5) and document date, context, and goals; align with patient’s functional impairment and goals.
recommended_plan.rationale: Discordant PCL-5/CAPS-5 with PHQ/stress entries requires interview-based reconciliation and timing/context documentation prior to making treatment decisions.
cautions: Avoid reliance on a single score; reconcile discordant data with clinical interview and contextual data

recommended_plan.text: Review sertraline dose, duration, adherence, perceived benefit, and adverse effects; confirm plan to continue, adjust, or refer for psychiatry input without prescribing changes within this draft.
recommended_plan.rationale: SSRIs have moderate-certainty support for PTSD; current sertraline use warrants dose/duration/adherence review and safety monitoring before any changes.
cautions: Do not modify sertraline dose or discontinue without a documented plan and medical coordination

recommended_plan.text: Offer a shared-decision discussion about re-engaging trauma-focused psychotherapy, prioritizing EMDR given prior response; if EMDR is unavailable or not preferred, discuss alternative evidence-based trauma-focused approaches with the patient.
recommended_plan.rationale: Prior EMDR responder history supports reconsideration of EMDR; discuss modality options within local availability and clinician expertise; reserve WET/PSYCH options as conditional or investigational rather than routine.
cautions: Re-engagement should be paced and tailored to dissociation, sleep, and medical comorbidity; availability may vary

recommended_plan.text: Assess current alcohol use pattern, cravings, consequences, withdrawal risk, and readiness for change; coordinate integrated PTSD-alcohol care and develop a withdrawal-safety plan if needed.
recommended_plan.rationale: Integrated PTSD and alcohol-use treatment is supported conceptually; direct evidence for alcohol-specific outcomes is indirect in the supplied passages.
cautions: Coordinate PTSD and alcohol-use treatment; avoid abrupt cessation without safety planning

recommended_plan.text: Establish a plan for regular measurement-based follow-up (e.g., PCL-5) and track patient-defined goals, functioning, sleep, and treatment engagement; document interval timing.
recommended_plan.rationale: Measurement-based follow-up clarifies progress and informs treatment decisions; repeated assessments should align with shared goals.
cautions: Ensure consistent use of the same instrument across follow-up; define goal milestones

monitoring: Repeat PTSD symptom measurement with a validated instrument (PCL-5 and/or CAPS-5) at predefined intervals to track change
Direct suicide/violence risk assessment at each contact and maintenance of a crisis plan
Regular safety checks for sleep disturbance, dissociation, agitation, sleep-wake cycle, and medication adverse effects
Ongoing alcohol-use assessment and screening for withdrawal risk; document readiness for change and engagement in integrated treatment
Monitor treatment attendance, adherence to the plan, and any adverse effects from sertraline
Document and review functional impairment related to work, cognition, and daily activities
reassessment_triggers: Worsening suicidality or emergence of self-harm thoughts
New or worsening withdrawal symptoms or dangerous alcohol-use pattern
Significant sleep disturbance, dissociation, or agitation
Poor engagement or nonresponse to planned psychotherapy
Adverse sertraline effects or suspected nonadherence
New medical or neurological symptoms (e.g., concussion-related issues)
